displayName: Proactive word prediction for NVDA users
description: Watches what you type and predicts the next word using n-gram analysis with Kneser-Ney smoothing. Predictions are announced through NVDA's speech engine and can be accepted with NVDA+Control+number keys (1 through 0). Learns from your writing over time. Includes partial-word prediction and terminal auto-detection and a custom app exclusion list and a settings panel.
